source_selection:
Exact commit URLs, byte lengths and SHA-256; section-bounded tables with exact headers and counts; raw rows retained before validation. Only S3 ID cells admit literal
separators.
locator_grammar: L<positive-line> or L<positive-line>#id=<canonical-app-id>; LF and CRLF each delimit one line.
normalization: Strict UTF-8; NFC human text; remove syntactic cell padding only; lowercase ASCII UUID hex; no UUID version/variant restriction; no ID repair; unsupported markup or controls fail.
identity: entry_id equals app_id; coalesce only equal ID and label, retaining every admitted source locator; disagreements fail. No tenant object IDs, inferred SPNs, verification or lifecycle claims.
aliases: Complete display labels plus the two explicitly documented current/former name pairs. NFC then ASCII lowercase keys; within-entry choose smallest exact UTF-8 spelling; omit cross-entry collisions from every entry; sort normalized key then bytes.
projection: Microsoft documentation attribution; empty SPNs; false deprecated; null replacement; empty extensions. S1: original editorial summary. S2-only: null description. S3-only: exact original historical note.
serialization: RFC 8785 entries ordered by entry_id with one final LF each; runtime v2 schemas and semantic validator; no truncation.
distribution: Apache-2.0 factual identifiers/names and original summaries only. Exact research sources and upstream licenses remain outside runtime archive.
failure: Missing/changed source or quarantine bytes, new malformed assertions, unsupported markup, name conflicts, count drift, unmatched editorial facts or baseline mismatch fail before public output.
